descripcion_geo: Vast desert south of Canaan and north of Sinai; scene of Hagar's pilgrimage to Ishmael and Moses's spies.
importancia_estrategica: Transit territory between Sinai and Canaan; home of Ishmael and Israelite pilgrimage route.

historias.titulo: Agar and Ishmael in the Paran desert
historias.descripcion: Expelled by Sara, Hagar wanders through the desert of Beersheba and Paran; Ishmael settles there and Hagar looks for Egypt's wife.
The Israelites camp in the desert of Paran before sending out the spies; there they receive the negative report.
When Samuel dies, David goes down to the desert of Paran where Nabal the rich man lives.

personajes.descripcion: He settled in the desert of Paran; God heard his cry and promised to make him a great nation.
He found the angel of the Lord in the desert; God heard the cry of his son in Paran.
He sent the twelve spies from the desert of Paran to reconnoiter Canaan.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Paran Desert: relevant geographical region in the Old Testament.

mitos.nombre: The God who hears in the desert

judaismo.descripcion: God heard the cry of Ishmael in the wilderness of Paran (Gen 21:17); The desert is the place where God listens to the one that no one else hears.
judaismo.significado_teologico: God heard the cry of Ishmael in the wilderness of Paran (Gen 21:17); The desert is the place where God listens to the one that no one else hears.

islam.descripcion: The Quran narrates how God heard Ishmael (Ismail) in the desert and promised to make him the father of a great nation (Cor 2:125).
islam.significado_teologico: The Quran narrates how God heard Ishmael (Ismail) in the desert and promised to make him the father of a great nation (Cor 2:125).
